name: squiggly-text

frames.best_why: The word squiggly shows the clearest wavy, doubled outline while the rest of the line stays sharp.

tagline: One word in a sentence jitters like a hand-drawn wave.
summary: Wraps any run of text in a live filter that keeps warping it, so a single word quivers and ruffles in place while the rest of the sentence stays crisp.
appearance: A single line of bold white text on black. One word inside it has slightly ragged, doubled edges, while the words around it stay perfectly sharp.
behaviour: The wrapped word is continuously displaced by a shifting noise filter that cycles through five shapes many times a second, so it shivers like a wobbly drawing. Nothing responds to input.
demo_content: The sentence 'Make your text squiggly and fun', with the word squiggly animated.
search_phrases: word that wobbles in a sentence
make part of a sentence animate
use_when: One playful word inside a headline should draw the eye without setting the whole sentence in motion.
avoid_when: Body copy or long text: constant turbulence hurts legibility and the filter costs work every frame.
customise: Wrap the text as children and tune steps, stepDuration, scale, baseFrequency, numOctaves and the element type through props.
weight_why: An SVG displacement filter is reapplied to the word about twelve times a second.

a11y.note: The text stays real text and the filter SVG is hidden from assistive tech, but the wobble ignores reduced-motion.

issues: The distortion is slight, so on a still the word reads almost like plain text.
polish_why: A tight, tidy filter trick; the wobble is so slight it can be missed at a glance.
title: Squiggly Text
